content.summary: Implemented changes footer with reactive summary and keybind hints

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Shows summary: N files changed with total additions/deletions
Shows keybind hints: esc close, ↑↓ navigate, enter select, c comment (if commenting is implemented), S submit
Integrated into the Changes route layout at the bottom
Updates reactively as file list data changes
Shows buffered comment count and submit enabled/disabled state

data.notes: FileList now emits reactive totals via onSummary. Changes route stores these totals and passes them into the new footer. Footer receives comments/submit props as hook points and currently displays a zero-buffer placeholder with disabled submit.
